welcomeMessage: Happy birthday to my favorite person. This little corner of the internet is just for you — come in and look around.

openWhen.label: Open when you're sad
openWhen.message: Hey. I know things feel heavy right now, but you are so loved and this feeling won't last forever. Call me if you need to — I'll pick up.

openWhen.label: Open when you're happy
openWhen.message: I love that you're happy right now. Tell me everything about it later — I want to hear all the details.

openWhen.label: Open when you miss me
openWhen.message: I miss you too, more than you know. We'll be together again soon. Until then, here's a little piece of me.

openWhen.label: Open when you need a laugh
openWhen.message: Remember that one time we couldn't stop laughing over absolutely nothing? Think about that. You're welcome.

openWhen.label: Open when you can't sleep
openWhen.message: Close your eyes. Picture somewhere calm — maybe somewhere we've been together. I'm sending you the sleepiest thoughts I can.

openWhen.label: Open when you want to celebrate
openWhen.message: Let's go! Whatever it is, I'm proud of you and I want to celebrate every single win with you, big or small.
